title: Equivalent normalized inputs produce byte-identical plans and diagnostic ordering
statement: Equivalent normalized XDL inputs must produce byte-identical activation plans with identical diagnostic ordering.
applicability: X-Verse capability 007 phase 4 derived activation plan; verified for the bounded T020 slice only.
verification_intent: Realized for the T020 test slice by T020-SR-001 and T020-SR-005.
acceptance_criteria: Byte-level canonical output equality across equivalent inputs in both languages.
Deterministic, declared-order diagnostics across equivalent inputs.
